changes.summary: Ask the History now knows every player's path: how each team got him, what he scored there, how title teams were built, and where every traded pick ended up.
changes.headline: Buck connects the dots
changes.lede: Ask the History now follows every player, pick and trade across The League's whole history: which trades built a title team, where a famous pick came from, the biggest game in a rivalry, and what-ifs like your best possible lineup.
changes.imageAlt: An Ask the History answer card with the question, the answer in big type, and a link to ask your own
